# 1. $\Delta \rightarrow Y$
$$
\begin{cases}
R_{1}=\frac{R_{12}R_{13}}{R_{12}+R_{23}+R_{31}} \\
 \\
R_{2}=\frac{R_{21}R_{23}}{R_{12}+R_{23}+R_{13}} \\
 \\
R_{3}=\frac{R_{31}R_{32}}{R_{12}+R_{23}+R_{13}} 
\end{cases}
$$
口诀：**Y 某臂电阻 = △相邻两边乘积 ÷ △三边总和**
# 2. $Y\rightarrow \Delta$
$$
\begin{cases}
R_{12}=R_{1}+R_{2}+\frac{R_{1}R_{2}}{R_{3}} \\
 \\
R_{23}=R_{2}+R_{3}+\frac{R_{2}R_{3}}{R_{1}} \\
 \\
R_{13}=R_{1}+R_{3}+\frac{R_{1}R_{3}}{R_{2}}
\end{cases}
$$
口诀：**△某边 = 相连两个 Y 电阻之和 + 两电阻乘积 ÷ 对面 Y 电阻**
